title: Ample positive twists detect a nonzero quasi-coherent complex
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal L$ be an ample invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module, def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Let $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], with no boundedness assumption. Use the derived tensor of [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] and put $H^p(X,E)=H^p(R\Gamma(X,E))$ with $R\Gamma$ as in [def-pc-global-derived-rhom]. If $K\not\simeq0$, there exist an integer $m\geq0$ and $p\in\mathbf Z$ such that
$$H^p\bigl(X,K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L^{\otimes m}\bigr)\neq0.$$

proof.text: Ampleness [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] includes quasi-compactness. By [lem-weil-pbc-ample-scheme-separated], $X$ is separated, hence quasi-separated: its closed-immersion diagonal is quasi-compact. Apply [lem-sfb-qc-separated-quasicoherent-complex-model] to choose $F^\bullet$ with quasi-coherent terms and $QF^\bullet\simeq K$. This uses neither a noetherian hypothesis nor a bound on the complex.

Some $\mathcal H^p(F^\bullet)$ is nonzero: otherwise $F^\bullet\to0$ is a quasi-isomorphism, so $K\simeq0$ by [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. There is a point $x$ where this sheaf has nonzero stalk. Indeed, if every stalk were zero, each section would vanish on a neighbourhood of every point, by the germ description in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], and hence vanish by the sheaf axiom. By [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] choose $n\geq1$ and $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$ with $x\in U=X_s$ affine. Put $M=\mathcal L^{\otimes n}$; on $U$ its section $s$ is a basis, since in every local rank-one frame its coefficient is a unit.

Put $Z=\ker(d^p:F^p	o F^{p+1})$. It is quasi-coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-kernel]. Factor $d^{p-1}$ through $Z$, and write $H=\operatorname{coker}(F^{p-1}	o Z)=\mathcal H^p(F^ ullet)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image], $H$ is quasi-coherent and $Z(U)	o H(U)$ is surjective. The affine counit of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] implies $H(U)
eq0$: otherwise $H|_U\simeq\widetilde{H(U)}=0$, contrary to $H_x
eq0$. Choose $0
eq	au\in H(U)$ and a lift $a\in Z(U)\subset F^p(U)$. Thus $d^p(a)=0$. Choose $y\in U$ with $	au_y
eq0$, using the same germ/sheaf argument as in step 2.

Apply [lem-sc-p1-section-clearing-denominators-qcqs] to the invertible module $M$, section $s$ and quasi-coherent module $F^p$. There are $b\geq0$ and $t\in\Gamma(X,F^p\otimes M^{\otimes b})$ with $t|_U=a\otimes s^{\otimes b}$. Its differential $v=(d^p\otimes1)(t)$ in $\Gamma(X,F^{p+1}\otimes M^{\otimes b})$ restricts to zero on $U$, because $a$ is a cycle. The coefficient $F^{p+1}\otimes M^{\otimes b}$ is quasi-coherent: on any trivialization of $M$ it is $F^{p+1}$. Apply [lem-sc-p1-section-restriction-s-torsion] to this coefficient and $s$. It gives $c\geq0$ with $v\otimes s^{\otimes c}=0$. Hence $z=t\otimes s^{\otimes c}$ is a global cycle of $G^\bullet=F^\bullet\otimes M^{\otimes(b+c)}$, and $z|_U=a\otimes s^{\otimes(b+c)}$. Both applications have a quasi-compact quasi-separated source by step 1.

The complex $G^\bullet$ represents $K\otimes^L\mathcal L^{\otimes N}$ for $N=n(b+c)\geq0$. To check the derived assertion directly, tensoring by a line bundle is exact on each trivializing open, where it is tensoring by $\mathcal O_X$. It therefore takes every acyclic complex to an acyclic complex, so the degree-zero line bundle is K-flat in [def-pc-kflat-complex]. The construction of [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] computes this derived tensor by the ordinary complex $G^\bullet$. At $y$, multiplication by $s_y^{\otimes(b+c)}$ is an isomorphism and identifies the class of $z_y$ with $\tau_y\neq0$. The stalk homology here is the stalk of the cohomology sheaf by [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact], applied to kernels, images and cokernels.

Choose a K-injective resolution $\rho:G^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], on the Zariski site of all opens of $X$ (a set in a sufficiently large fixed universe). By [def-pc-global-derived-rhom], $H^p(X,QG^\bullet)$ is $H^p(\Gamma(X,I^\bullet))$. The global cycle $\rho(z)$ defines a class there. If it were zero, there would be $w\in\Gamma(X,I^{p-1})$ with $d(w)=\rho(z)$; taking germs at $y$ makes $\rho_y(z_y)$ a boundary. But [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact] makes $\rho_y$ a quasi-isomorphism, since $\rho$ is one and stalks preserve kernels, images and cokernels. Thus the nonzero class of $z_y$ from step 5 cannot map to a boundary. This contradiction proves $H^p(X,K\otimes^L\mathcal L^{\otimes N})\neq0$, with $N\geq0$ as required.

The item statement is unchanged and matches 0BQR exactly: any X, L ample, K≠0 in D_QCoh with no bound; RΓ=Rp_* and the K-flat derived tensor. The six steps carry the whole Stacks proof. (1) Ample gives qc, the ampleness node gives separated, which gives qs (the affine-intersection fact is two lines); the new node then gives a model F• with quasi-coherent terms. (2) Some H^p(F) has a nonzero stalk; ample def (2) gives x in X_s affine with s a basis there. (3) The kernel node, cokernel-image clauses (2)/(3) and the tilde-Γ counit (3) give H(U)≠0 and a cycle lift a with τ_y≠0. (4) Both lem-sc-p1 nodes (01PW) apply with qcqs X and an invertible M=L^n; they yield z=t⊗s^c, a global cycle of F⊗M^{b+c}. (5) L^N[0] is K-flat, so the ordinary tensor computes the derived tensor; the cone argument is a few lines, so 'elementary' is acceptable. Stalk exactness identifies the class of z_y with τ_y. (6) A K-injective resolution exists because the site of opens is small; def-pc-global-derived-rhom gives H^p(Γ(X,I)); if ρ(z) were a boundary, its germ at y would be one, which contradicts ρ_y being a quasi-iso. N=n(b+c)≥0 as required. New node lem-sfb-qc-separated-quasicoherent-complex-model: it is true as 08DB essential surjectivity, since separated implies affine diagonal. I tested it on affine X, empty X and unbounded K on P^n. It is self-contained, statement-only and unsplit, with source 08DB plus label, correct blueprint from/via, same_as [] and 8 searches; it does not restate the item. rg -L over dag/nodes for 08DB, 0BQR, affine diagonal, D(QCoh) and quasi-coherent-model wording found no duplicate; dq-coherator, tor-independent, alternating-Čech and affine models all state something else.
